name: shell-layout
title: Shell Layout
description: The shell's layout rule as one pure function — resolveShellLayout decides, for a width, whether the column takes room and whether the panel docks beside the page, folds the column, slides over the page or goes full screen — plus the shell's sizes, page minimums, cookies and width clamps.

meta.whenToUse: Code that must know where the shell puts the column and panel without a DOM — a server deciding how a record opens, a test, a docs table — or the shell's sizes and cookie format.
meta.whenNotToUse: Laying the shell out: Shell does that in CSS before hydration; read the live outcome with useShellLayout.
